defects.description: Instructions say tuck both feet underneath the body TO ONE SIDE (asymmetric, both feet to one side of hips). Derived L/R hip flexion 80/80 symmetric, L/R hip_abduction 0/0 symmetric, L/R knee 138/138 symmetric. Legs are mirror-symmetric — no side-tuck at all. Sweep flagged this correctly.
Instructions say lean into the armrest with one elbow (torso tilted laterally toward armrest). Derived torso lateral_flexion = 0 (no tilt). Body is upright, not leaning into armrest.
Instructions say lean into the armrest with one elbow (elbow resting on armrest at hip height). Right arm: elbow flexion 9.9 deg (nearly straight). No bent-elbow shape to rest on armrest.

regression_risk: medium - 3-field change addressing 3 distinct description claims. hipAbductL negative crosses leg inward; if renderer geometry wraps unexpectedly, may produce anomaly. hips negative tilt is unusual but small magnitude. rightElbow large increase (18 to 80) is anatomically normal for armrest lean.
rationale: Three independent fixes for three defects. (1) hipAbductL: -30 (raw negative = crosses inward per FK) — left leg crosses rightward so both feet end up tucked to figure right side; right leg stays neutral (already on right side, tucked under right hip). Addresses knees_to_one_side. (2) hips: -8 — per FK hips rotZ + = pelvis tilts left (left hip drops = body leans LEFT); NEGATIVE hips = right hip drops = body leans RIGHT into right armrest. Addresses torso lateral lean. (3) rightElbow: 80 (from 18) — bend right elbow sharply so forearm extends forward, forming a clear elbow joint that rests on armrest at hip height. leftElbow 60 stays (already bent, free hand in lap). Note: leftShoulder field absent (defaults) — arm hangs at side, OK for hand in lap.
